$comment: What a release bundles. Node and MongoDB are checked against the checksums their vendors publish; WinSW and the MongoDB tools publish none, so their SHA-256 is pinned here (taken from the first download, 22 Sep 2026). Changing a version means changing its hash.

vcRedist.$comment: Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 runtime (x64). mongod.exe needs msvcp140/vcruntime140, which a fresh Windows may lack; the installer runs it only when mongod cannot start without it. The URL is the one aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe resolved to on 22 Sep 2026; its path carries the file's SHA-256.
